cases.purpose: Save binary content over its own source and retain permissions.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/chmod 640 data
nano2 save data data; echo "rc=$?" > rc
/usr/bin/stat -c "%a" data > mode
/usr/bin/ls -A > listing
cases.oracle: Direct byte, status, directory listing and POSIX file mode expectations.
cases.comparison: Compare status and every specified file.

cases.purpose: A rename failure after creating the temporary file leaves the target and its parent clean.
cases.script:
nano2 save src target 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?" > rc
/usr/bin/ls -A > listing
cases.oracle: Direct byte, status, directory listing and POSIX file mode expectations.
cases.comparison: Compare status and every specified file.

cases.purpose: A missing input fails without creating or replacing the destination.

cases.purpose: A new destination respects the caller umask.
cases.script:
umask 027
nano2 save src dst; echo "rc=$?" > rc
/usr/bin/stat -c "%a" dst > mode
